message:
## Vulnerability Digest

**Scan window:** 17 November 2026 07:40 to 18 November 2026 07:40 UTC (13:10 IST on each day).
**Scope:** DLL_software_component.txt only, with duplicates consolidated, plus the mandatory MongoDB ecosystem sweep.

No new vulnerability was verified as both reported within the window and relevant to a listed DLL component or the MongoDB ecosystem in the sources searched.

### MongoDB ecosystem
The dedicated search covered MongoDB Server and editions, mongod/mongos, Atlas and services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, mongosh, database tools, Kubernetes operators, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, integrations and MongoDB-owned libraries and advisories, including titles without the MongoDB name. Searches included MongoDB's [security alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts), CVE/NVD, GitHub advisories, CISA and security research. MongoDB's [CVE-2026-118383 announcement](https://www.mongodb.com/community/forums/t/important-mongodb-security-update-available-action-required-november-10-2026/344843) is dated 10 November and is outside this window.

**Closing:** No immediate review is recommended on the basis of a newly verified finding in this digest. Search coverage of the extensive inventory is limited, and absence of a finding does not establish that components are secure. Some entries have unversioned, inferred or inconsistent versions, which limits matching confidence.
